description: Amendments to the works consented under 2023/2843 in respects of proposed changes to the south, rear bay, and west elevations, along with internal modifications to include alterations to the lead parapets, window weatherproofing, internal staircase wall linings, a chimney breast in G5, stair balustrades, floorboarding, fireproofing, rebuilding a basement partition, and strengthening for the new staircase.
decision_conditions: <p>All new works and works of making good to the retained fabric, whether internal or external, shall be finished to match the original work with regard to the methods used and to material, dimensions, composition, form, colour, finish and profile unless otherwise specified in the details hereby approved, and shall be maintained as such thereafter.&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p>REASON: In order to protect the special interest of the listed building.&nbsp;</p>

The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

The Development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 18(a) of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 as amended.

<p>The following shall be submitted to the LPA for approval within 3 months of the date of this consent:</p><p>a) Details of the new windows and doors proposed to be installed on the rear elevation at basement level including scale elevations at 1:20 and sections and details at 1:5 (with the window and masonry surround shown on all drawings), product details (if applicable), material, colour and finish.&nbsp;</p><p>b) Details of the render proposed to be applied to the rear elevation at basement level (material, colour and finish)</p><p>c) Details (including large scale drawings, material, colour and finish) of the two new doors and surrounds proposed to be installed in the first floor corridor</p><p>d) Details (including drawings) of the proposed plumbing, waste pipes and ventilation arrangements for the two new WCs proposed on the second floor (southwest corner and southeast corner).</p><p>The development shall not be occupied until the details have been approved in writing by the LPA. Work shall be carried out in accordance with the details so approved and shall be maintained as such thereafter.</p><p><br></p><p>REASON: In order to protect the special interest of the listed building.</p>

<p>Details of the proposed works to floorboards shall be submitted to the LPA for approval within 3 months of the date of this consent. The details should include:</p><p>a) Scale plans showing the extent of floorboards to be lifted.&nbsp;</p><p>b) Details of the arrangements for storing and securing the boards on site prior to their reinstallation</p><p>c) A methodology for the repair and restoration of the floors including details of work to the historic boards and details of any new/supplementary materials to be incorporated.</p><p>The development shall not be occupied until the details have been approved in writing by the LPA. Work shall be carried out in accordance with the details so approved and shall be maintained as such thereafter.</p><p><br></p><p>REASON: In order to protect the special interest of the listed building.&nbsp;</p>

<p>Details of the proposed air source heat pump and heating system shall be submitted to the LPA for approval within 3 months of the date of this consent. The details should include:</p><p>a) Details of the proposed external equipment including a plan showing its location, product and size information, and details of any proposed housing.&nbsp;</p><p>b) Details of the internal system including any tanks, risers and heat emitters (including scale plans showing the layout and product/system specifications). The details should demonstrate how these have been arranged so as to avoid harm to historic fabric and features, and how they have been designed to avoid causing heat damage to the historic boards and floor structure.&nbsp;</p><p>The development shall not be occupied until the details have been approved in writing by the LPA. Work shall be carried out in accordance with the details so approved and shall be maintained as such thereafter.</p><p><br></p><p>REASON: In order to protect the special interest of the listed building.</p>

<p>Copies of the recordings of the panelled partition between the hallway and front reception room at ground floor and of the relocated partition wall in the basement that were made during unauthorised works shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the LPA prior to the occupation of the development.&nbsp; &nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p>REASON: In order to protect the special interest of the listed building.</p>
